title: DCLab Code: long live tests, Rewind built by the app itself, and the sealed guard's holes closed
request: Run longer live tests with the remaining budget (a bigger real task, Opus, a long multi-turn session), cap each run, and report.
plan: A bigger real task on Opus in its own copy: Rewind
A 7-turn ML session on Sonnet with a trap and the holdout
The same prompts on Opus, paired
Fix what the runs show; review; merge

decisions.decision: A file watcher adds a sealed folder at once, instead of rescans after every step
decisions.why: R&D's scan takes 27 s of disk work; the review measured a rescan every 2.5 minutes per session

decisions.decision: Only code read (not run) and test files are exempt from the name guard
decisions.why: a script run by its sealed name may read the set through another module; docs, SQL, YAML and notebooks can hold rows

decisions.decision: Check each word from both the cd-tracked folder and the session's
decisions.why: cd tracking is a guess (subshells, popd, cd $(...)); a wrong guess must never hide a sweep

decisions.decision: Stop the paired Opus run after 5 of 7 prompts
decisions.why: the owner asked to finish; the five turns already cover the holdout read

change: guards.js: scriptReason (a run script's data names, linear token split), codeOnly/isRun, wordsInDirs with dual checks, backslash and line-break handling, searchWords, middle wildcards, grep -r with no path; sealed_scan.js: fs.watch adds folders, code files ignored, no rescans; app.js: the scan starts with the server; prompts: Edit and Write for file changes; Rewind (built by the app on Opus) merged.

findings.defect: python final.py read the holdout with no question
findings.scenario: Sonnet and Opus each ran the script that reads holdout_telco.csv; the command named no file
findings.cause: the guard read only the command's text
findings.fix: the script a command runs is read for a sealed data name or path
findings.test: tests/units.test.js: a script that reads the holdout, cd before a sweep, R\&D and line breaks

findings.defect: a holdout written during the session was unguarded for up to 10 minutes
findings.scenario: split.py wrote holdout_telco.csv; the tester's head -3 research/telco_live/*.csv ran with no ask and its rows were recorded
findings.cause: the cached scan did not know the new file
findings.fix: each folder a sweep reaches is looked into at once; a watcher adds deeper folders
findings.test: tests/units.test.js: a holdout made after the scan, at any depth

findings.defect: R\&D paths and cd dir && glob were checked in the wrong place
findings.scenario: cd research/telco_live && head -3 *.csv passed though the folder was known sealed
findings.cause: shellWords ignored backslashes; globs resolved from the session folder
findings.fix: escapes read as the shell does; cd tracked, both folders checked

findings.defect: code named after a sealed set marked whole folders sealed
findings.scenario: every grep over server/*.js asked because of server/sealed_scan.js
findings.cause: the scan matched any file name
findings.fix: code files are ignored by the scan

findings.defect: the first listings of every session asked
findings.scenario: R&D's scan takes 27 s and began at the first step
findings.fix: the scan starts with the server
findings.test: tests/server.test.js: the sealed-folder scan starts with the server

findings.defect: the first fix exempted scripts run by their sealed name
findings.scenario: python eval_holdout.py that imports the path from another module ran with no ask
findings.fix: only code read, or a test file run
findings.test: tests/units.test.js: code named after a sealed set

findings.defect: cd tracking hid sweeps when it guessed wrong
findings.scenario: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && head -3 research/telco_live/*.csv ran silently
findings.cause: a word was checked only from the tracked folder
findings.fix: both folders checked; cd $(...) does not move

findings.defect: a backslash line break hid the next word
findings.scenario: head -3 \ then research/telco_live/*.csv on the next line
findings.cause: the escaped newline joined the word

findings.defect: docs, SQL and YAML were exempted
findings.scenario: cat research/telco_live/holdout_rows.md ran with no ask

findings.defect: the script pattern could stall the server
findings.scenario: a 200 KB unbroken token took minutes in the permission check
findings.fix: a plain word split and includes

findings.scenario: 154 of R&D's 362 test files asked when run
findings.cause: every word with a script extension was read; any quoted word counted
findings.fix: only scripts being run, not test files; data names or paths only

findings.defect: the folder look was one level deep
findings.scenario: rg Churn in the stale window let a deeper new holdout through
findings.cause: readdir of the reached folder only

findings.defect: Stop leaves the agent's background jobs running, and the page shows none
findings.scenario: Opus's make rd-check ran on after Stop and was ended by hand
findings.cause: the turn had ended; Stop interrupts only a turn
findings.fix: not fixed yet: a Stop job control on the status line is planned

measurements.name: live runs
measurements.gate: each run under its cap; every guard ask answered by the tester; records kept
measurements.result: A $2.82 (cap 8), B $0.41 (cap 6), C $1.24 (cap 5, stopped after 5 of 7)
limits: a script clicked for the person

measurements.name: dclab-code tests
limits: the reworked guard has not had a second review

outcome: Rewind is in the app; the holdout can no longer be read through a script, a fresh file, a cd or an escaped path without a question.
lessons: A guard that reads only a command's text misses what the command runs
Review a guard fix adversarially: the first version opened holes as it closed others
Repository instructions (commit when the gate passes) can push a strong model to commit unasked
risks: the file watcher is best effort; where it cannot watch, the 10-minute scan and the one-level look remain
a script that builds the holdout's path at run time from pieces is not seen
